Our driver, Mr. Rakesh, was very polite, professional, and experienced. He had good knowledge of the routes, temple timings, and nearby facilities. His driving was safe and smooth, which made the journey comfortable for elders and children.
The Tempo Traveller was clean, spacious, and well-maintained, making long-distance travel pleasant. Proper stops for food and rest were taken and the entire trip was well-coordinated and stress-free.
Overall, it was a memorable and peaceful family spiritual trip.
Special thanks to Mr. Pritesh and Shree KalBhairav Tours and Travels for their excellent service.
Highly recommended for family and pilgrimage tours! 🙏🚍
